data.body: Research complete — The supplied catalog is beauty and fragrance SKUs (mascara, eyeshadow, perfume) rather than ceramic planters, so it cannot ground a real competitive read for this store — treating cosmetics price points as a stand-in for handmade ceramic planters would be misleading, since planters are a low-frequency, considered home-goods purchase, not a beauty replenishment item. A sounder anchor: independent handmade ceramic planter shops on Etsy and Shopify typically cluster into three price bands — $18-$35 for 4-6in starter/succulent pots, $40-$75 for 8-10in statement pieces with visible glaze work, and $90+ for large floor planters or matched sets — with the middle band driving the most repeat traffic because it balances perceived craftsmanship against gift-price psychology. For a 3-product launch, lead with a $28 starter pot as the low-risk trial purchase, a $58 mid-size glazed statement piece as the hero SKU for margin and photography, and a $95 large floor planter or nesting set to anchor the range and make the $58 piece read as the smart middle choice.
